content.thinking: Bug in my sweep script: for kind != 'big' I need 'pat'. I used "kind":"cg" but the code expects kind='big' or else sp['pat']. Let me fix: treat kind as the pattern name if not 'big'.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='perfsweep.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    inst = biggen.build(seed, **sp) if kind=='big' else hardgen.PATTERNS[sp.pop('pat')](seed=seed, **sp)",
            "    inst = biggen.build(seed, **sp) if kind=='big' else hardgen.PATTERNS[kind](seed=seed, **sp)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
timeout 175 python3 perfsweep.py '[
{"kind":"cg","seed":1},{"kind":"cg","seed":2,"ngroups":3},{"kind":"cg","seed":3,"ngroups":7},
{"kind":"sp","seed":1,"W":3},{"kind":"sp","seed":2,"W":7},{"kind":"xs","seed":1},{"kind":"tc","seed":1},
{"kind":"cg","seed":4,"ngroups":4,"wide":false},{"kind":"cg","seed":5,"ngroups":14,"nobs_extra":0}]' 50
